{{Quote|This ship is the ''Onyx Cinder''. You don't appreciate how incredible this is. Tak Rennod's the most infamous pirate the galaxy's ever known. For years, he roamed the skies, plundering, terrorizing whole star systems. Anything he wanted… he took it. The story goes, he was after the treasure of At Attin aboard the mysterious ship the ''Onyx Cinder'' when he just… [blows air sharply] disappeared. Crew, ship. All.|[[Jod Na Nawood]]|<ref name="Lot to Learn" />}}
The '''''Onyx Cinder''''' was a [[Galactic Republic]] [[starship]] utilized for [[credit ingot]] transportation from a Republic [[At Attin Mint|mint]]. At some point, it was stolen by the notorious [[pirate]] [[Tak Rennod]]. Based in [[Skull Ridge Mountain]] on the [[planet]] [[Lanupa]], Rennod ruled the spacelanes for years, and ultimately used the ship to bypass the [[Barrier]] of the mint planet [[At Attin]], but the mission resulted in the death of the entire crew after a mutiny and the ''Cinder'' became buried in a forest. The only surviving crew member was the [[droid]] [[SM-33]].

In [[9 ABY]], a [[youngling]] named [[Wim]] discovered it and, together with three other children [[Neel]], [[Fern]] and [[KB]], investigated the ship, in the process accidentally activating its [[engine]]s and [[hyperdrive]] and jumped into [[hyperspace]]. The [[Skeleton Crew|group of kids]] then forged an alliance with SM-33 and a [[Force-sensitive]] man called [[Jod Na Nawood]] to find their way back home and avoid a [[Silvo's pirates|band of pirates]] led by [[Captain]] [[Brutus]].<ref name="Astrogation Problem" />

==Description==
{{Dialogue|Jod Na Nawood|Now then, which of these ships is yours?|Wim|Uh, well… Okay, I think you should know that our ship, it—it's—|Fern|He's trying to tell you it's a wreck, but he's too embarrassed.|KB|Technically, it shouldn't fly.|Neel|It smells funny.|Nawood|Well, can't smell as bad as—''[notices the ''Onyx Cinder'']'' Wait. Not that?|attr=[[Jod Na Nawood]], [[Wim]], [[Fern]], [[KB]], and [[Neel]]|src=<ref name="Astrogation Problem" />}}
[[File:Onyx_Cinder_cockpit.png|thumb|left|300px|The cockpit of the ''Onyx Cinder'' ]]
The ''Onyx Cinder'' was a medium-sized [[starship]] similar to a [[light freighter]] with a [[chrome]]-colored [[hull]]. It had a [[hyperdrive]] and eight [[engine]]s located at the rear, four of which were stationary and four others that could be rotated 90 degrees for landing. The front of the ship was covered with a [[color|black]]-colored hull sleeve with four white stripes and two additional engines<ref name="Zero" /> which gave it the appearance of an older, damaged starship;<ref name="Astrogation Problem" /> this could be fully blown off using the [[Emergency hull demolition sequencer]].<ref name="Zero" /> The ''Cinder'' was also equipped with four extendable landing legs, two [[entry ramp|entry ramps]] (one at the front and one at the rear), and two dorsal [[laser cannon]] [[turret]]s. The hull sleeve contained five larger dual laser cannons. Three of these were mounted on the starboard side, with two on top and one on bottom. A fourth one was located on the bottom of the port side, and the other was mounted on the side of the cockpit.<ref name="Astrogation Problem" />

Its [[cockpit]] had a big [[Viewport|window]] at the front and two other different sized windows at its sides. It contained a seat for the pilot and copilot, as well as one for a navigator .<ref name="Real Adventure" /> By around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the ''Onyx Cinder'' was almost completely buried in dirt, [[Plant|roots]] grew from its overhead and small [[Species|animals]] lived in it. [[SM-33]] had become corroded and decrepit, walking with a limp as the result of the loss of his left foot. The [[Skeleton|skeletal]] remains of two individuals were found in a compartment, one pinned to a bulkhead by a [[knife]] in its chest.<ref name="Real Adventure" /> Despite its bulky appearance, the ''Onyx Cinder'' was quite maneuverable, able to evade and outrun pursuers.<ref name="Astrogation Problem" />

==History==
===Infiltrating the mint===
{{Quote|Aye, that was Captain Rennod's genius! Stealin' one of the Mint's own ships so he could fly it safely back through!|SM-33|<ref name="We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble" />}}
[[File:OnyxCinder-SCPatchRelics.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Onyx Cinder'' takes off]]
The ''Onyx Cinder'' originally belonged to the [[Galactic Republic]], being utilized as the [[transport]] for one of its hidden [[Galactic Credit Standard|Credit]] [[At Attin Mint|mints]], and was built there.<ref name="Real Good Guys">{{SkeletonCrew|The Real Good Guys}}</ref> As such, it was uniquely able to bypass the protective [[Barrier]] enveloping [[planet]]s like At Attin and [[At Achrann]], which normally destroyed any starships attempting to pass through. At some point, legendary [[pirate]] [[Tak Rennod]], researching the legend of the "treasure planet" At Attin discovered its nature as a Republic mint and stole the ''Cinder'' to penetrate its defenses and infiltrate the planet.<ref name="We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble" /> Rennod [[armor]]ed the ship<ref name="Lot to Learn" /> with an additional hull sleeve and extra engines and weapons<ref name="Zero" /> and hired a well-trained [[Tak Rennod's pirates|pirate crew]] for the mission, making sure to record his plans in his captain's log in [[Skull Ridge Mountain]]. After leaving his [[Captain Rennod's Lair|lair]] behind, he, [[SM-33]] and his crew made for At Attin, however, a mutiny followed, during which Rennod killed his entire crew but was fatally wounded by [[Tak Rennod's concubine|his concubine]] and perished, with the ship successfully going through the barrier, but crash-landing into the surface, leaving SM-33 trapped inside the upside-down wreckage for years.<ref name="Lot to Learn" /> 

===Re-discovery by the Skeleton Crew===
[[File:OnyxCinderArmored.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Onyx Cinder'' was wrapped in an armored hull-sleeve.]]
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate}} As {{SW|url=news/swca-2022-20-highlights-from-lucasfilms-studio-showcase|text=SWCA 2022: 20 Highlights from Lucasfilm's Studio Showcase}} states that ''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' is set in the same time period as ''The Mandalorian'', it must therefore also be set around 9 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]].</ref> a child from At Attin, [[Wim]], discovered the entrance to the ''Cinder'' buried in the forest while taking a short-cut to [[At Attin Middle School Gamma|his school]]. Believing it to be the gate to a [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]], Wym took his friend [[Neel]] there later to dig it out; they were however followed by [[Fern]] and [[KB]] who called "[[claimsies]]" on the door, promising to leave whatever was inside for the boys in exchange for digging the entrance out. The boys reluctantly complied, and the group entered the ''Cinder''. The door was however locked behind them, forcing them to look for a power source to re-open it. KB found one of the ''Cinder's'' engines, realizing that the structure was in fact a spaceship, and asking the kids not to touch anything. However Wim had already found the cockpit and pressed the start button, causing the ship's engines to ignite, righting it and lifting off. Despite the kids; attempts to stop it, the ship took off and jumped to [[hyperspace]].<ref name="Real Adventure" />

Upon exiting hyperspace far away from At Attin, the kids panicked, not knowing how to return. At this point, SM-33 appeared, having been reactivated along with the ship. After initially attempting to attack the kids due to perceiving them as infiltrators to Tak Rennod's ship, he was convinced by Fern that she had in fact been the one who killed him, causing the droid to recognize her as the new rightful captain of the ship. Fern then ordered SM-33 to return the ship to At Attin; having been ordered by Rennod not to reveal its location to anyone, SM-33 claimed he couldn't say he had heard of the place and pointed out the need for the ship to be repaired due to sustaining heavy damages from years of abandonment. Following his advice, the kids had 33 fly the ship to the [[shadowport]] [[Borgo Prime]], where the ship was docked and the kids disembarked to find directions to At Attin. After briefly being kidnapped by [[Silvo's pirates]] due to revealing their old Republic credits in a [[cantina]],<ref name="Past">{{SkeletonCrew|Way, Way Out Past the Barrier}}</ref> the kids were able to escape back to the ship with SM-33 and fellow prisoner [[Jod Na Nawood]].<ref name="Astrogation Problem" />

===Adventures with Nawood===
Nawood took the kids' claims about At Attin seriously, having heard of the treasure planet legend himself, and agreed to take the kids home as long as he was rewarded for his actions with part of the planet's treasure. To find the coordinates of the planet, Nawood took the kids to the [[Observatory Moon]] to meet with [[astronomer]] [[Kh'ymm]]. While she managed to discover the coordinates of another [[Jewels of the Old Republic|Jewel of the Old Republic]], At Achrann, thanks to the kids' descriptions of their home, Kh'ymm also called in a [[New Republic]] patrol suspecting that Jod had kidnapped the kids. The patrol's [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]]s engaged the ''Cinder'', trying to force it to land without harming the kids, but Jod had Fern and Wim man the [[turret]]s and fire back. In the ensuing battle, the Skeleton Crew managed to damage one of the two [[starfighter]]s and jump to At Achrann.<ref name="Astrogation Problem" />

After arriving and landing in [[At Achrann]], the kids had SM-33 keep Nawood to the ship and went out to explore. The starship was however discovered by a [[Hattan]] patrol, forcing Nawood to spend all of the kids' credits he had previously stolen to buy their [[eopie]]es and rescue the kids from the [[Troik]]. While on the planet, the Skeleton Crew and Jod discovered SM-33's programming about not revealing At ttin to anyone, as well as his backstory with Rennod,<ref name="Can't say">{{SkeletonCrew|Can't Say I Remember No At Attin}}</ref> realizing that the coordinates for the treasure planet could only be on Rennod's lair under the Skullridge Mountain. The Crew arrived at [[Lanupa]], but to SM-33's surprise the mountain had been turned into a [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa|luxury hotel]], which didn't allow any children in the premises. Rennod took over, pretending that the ''Cinder'' was the transport of the Wise Elders of the [[Bratric system]] and dressing the kids accordingly.<ref name="Lot to Learn" />  

===A new ship===
{{Dialogue|Nawood|I claim this ship. I claim the ''Onyx Cinder''. I am the captain of this ship and you all take orders from me.|Fern|I call unclaimsies!|Nawood|What?|Fern|I call unclaimsies and claim it for kids only! 33, take these pirates off our ship.|Nawood|I'm afraid it doesn't work like that. ''[SM-33 punches Jod in the face]'' |SM-33|Aye, but it be close enough!|attr=[[Jod Na Nawood]], [[Fern]] and [[SM-33]]|src=<ref name="We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble" />}}
[[File:The_true_Onyx_Cinder.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Onyx Cinder's'' true form.]]
The crew then made their way to Rennod's lair under the mountain, pursued by Nawood's old crew which had been alerted by [[Pokkit]]. Inside the lair they found Rennod's treasure and log, containing the coordinates to At Attin, at which point Nawood used his right to challenge Fern's captainship, forcing her to surrender and taking over the ''Onyx Cinder'' as its captain.<ref name="Lot to Learn" /> Before he could escape with it however he was detained by [[Gunter]] and taken prisoner on board his [[Silvo's pirate frigate|frigate]]. Abandoned on the [[hangar]], the ''Cinder'' was taken by the hotel crew to be scrapped in the trash fields by a massive [[scrapper barge]]. The kids were able to reach the ship on time and KB took over the controls while Wim went to the turret to shoot the barge off, but the engines weren't powerful enough to escape and the barge got a hold of the forward hull, tearing it off. With all other measures exhausted, Fern pressed the [[Emergency hull demolition sequencer]], which blew off the armored hull sleeve the barge was attached to and allowed the ''Cinder'' to remove itself from the wreck and fly away, escaping certain doom.<ref name="Zero" />

Having finally obtained the coordinates for At Attin, the kids jumped directly to it, but upon arrival they were trapped by the pirate frigate's [[tractor beam]], as Nawood had taken the pirate crew there first. Having realized that the ship was the key to entering the planet, Nawood had his pirates board it and SM-33 search for the beacon that allowed it to pass through the barrier field. SM-33 pointed out that Nawood was the captain of the pirate frigate now, and as such couldn't captain another ship. Wim saw the chance to claim captainship on the ''Cinder'' again, but Nawood claimed it first. Fern desperately called "unclaimsies" to reclaim the ship for kids only, and although this wasn't part of the [[Pirate's Code]], SM-33 complied, attacking the pirates and kicking them off the ship. Despite the pirates attempting to pursue them through the barrier, their ships were destroyed by the planet's defenses with only the Cinder making it through.<ref name="We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble" />

===Back to At Attin===
{{Quote|Citizens of At Attin, this is the Supervisor speaking. An Emissary is arriving for a shipment. All non-essential work is suspended until Offload is complete. Thank you.|The At Attin Supervisor announcing the ''Onyx Cincer's'' arrival|<ref name="We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble" />}}
After the ship cleared the field, Nawood revealed himself, having boarded the ''Cinder'' before it left the pirate frigate, sliced SM-33's head off with [[Unidentified lightsaber (Lanupa)|Tak Rennod's lightsaber]] and threatened to kill the kids' parents if they intervened. The planet's droids recognized the ship as belonging to a Republic envoy having arrived to collect a credit shipment and allowed the ''Cinder'' to land on the central landing platform, welcoming him and taking him directly to the vault.<ref name="We're Gonna Be In So Much Trouble" /> He claimed to be both a Republic Emissary and Jedi. As the droids loaded the ''Cinder'', Nawood asked to taken to [[The Supervisor]].<ref name="Real Good Guys" />

After Nawood destroyed the Supervisor, Wim, [[Wendle]], and [[KB]] were able to free the ''Onyx'' from the docking clamps. KB was able to repair [[SM-33]] and the two of them were able to fly the ship past Nawood's pirates' fighters and the [[Barrier]]. KB was able to contact [[Kh'ymm]] and she was able to contact the [[New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Force|Defense Force]]. Hit by fire from the pirates, the ''Onyx'' was no longer capable of being airborne and crashed into the [[At Attin Middle School Gamma|At Attin's Middle School]]. However, thanks to the skills of KB and SM-33, the landing was somewhat cushioned by last-second maneuvers before impacting a building, allowing all aboard to survive.<ref name="Real Good Guys" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Onyx Cinder'' appears in the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]''. It was first identified in a listing by [[Wikipedia:Germany|German]] retailer [[Wikipedia:Müller (store)|Müller]] revealing the [[LEGO]] set [[w:c:brickipedia:75374 The Onyx Cinder|75374 The Onyx Cinder]].<ref name="SkelCrewReveal">{{WebCite|url=https://www.mueller.de/p/lego-star-wars-75374-skeleton-crew-die-onyx-cinder-IPN3006172|text=LEGO Star Wars 75374 Skeleton Crew Die Onyx Cinder|date=2024-07-29|work=[[Wikipedia:Müller (store)|Müller]]|language=German|archivedate=20240729184548}}</ref> The ''Onyx Cinder'' was the show's largest practical set, with large parts being fully built and having working technology and mechanics.<ref name="Production Brief">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/nqhmfrs8frp9v9pbnbt9cw|text=SKELETON CREW Production Brief FINAL 11-11-24.pdf|author=[[The Walt Disney Company|The Walt Disney Studios]]|date=2024-11-18}}</ref> Speaking to ''Tech Radar'' ahead of the series premier in an interview published the day after its release, ''Skeleton Crew'' co-creator [[Christopher Ford]] affirmed the vessel's name to be the ''Onyx Cinder'' and that there was a story behind it. According to Ford, whoever named the ship "was trying to make it sound cool."<ref name="Name confirmed">{{WebCite|url=https://www.techradar.com/streaming/disney-plus/yes-star-wars-skeleton-crews-starship-has-a-name-and-its-co-creator-says-there-is-a-story-meaning-behind-it-that-ties-into-the-shows-biggest-mystery|text=Yes, Star Wars: Skeleton Crew's starship has a name – and its co-creator says 'there is a story meaning behind it' that ties into the show's biggest mystery|author=Power, Tom|date=2024-12-03|work=''Tech Radar''|archivedate=20250308010433}}</ref> On April 24, 2025, it was mentioned by John Goodson, the maker of the Onyx Cinder model, that the ship had been buried on At Attin for 100 years.<ref>{{YouTube|video=K0aR9sPXV7I|text=How This Star Wars Filming Model Was Built With No 3D Printing!|channel=@tested|name=tested}}</ref> The digital version of the ship was modeled by [[Jay Machado]] of [[Industrial Light & Magic|Industrial Light and Magic]] with textures painted by [[Kim Vongbunyong]].<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|231|Model Behavior: Inside the Onyx Cinder|Model Behavior: Inside the ''Onyx Cinder''}}</ref>
